Critics are sounding the alarm after President Donald Trump shared a bizarre image celebrating Nvidia’s decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as its CEO and president.

The president reposted what appears to be an AI-generated image of the 2024 assassination attempt in Butler, Pennsylvania, but with Huang in Trump’s place, complete with blood across his face.

Instead of a raised fist, the AI Huang is holding a red bra ― and the United States flag in the background of the real photo has been replaced by one bearing the Nvidia logo.

Huang had resigned earlier this month after admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy and reportedly had multiple affairs with company employees.

Many were astounded that the president would use something as serious as an attempt on his life ― one in which a bystander was killed ― as fodder for a joke.
